conventions.frames: <prefix><NNNN>.png, 1080x1920 RGB, NNNN = native frame index of the source clip (LAYL: film frame number). One native frame per 30 fps timeline frame; never reversed, never blended.
conventions.n: For a use with timeline range [f0, f1]: frame f shows n[f - f0]. "rule" says the same in words.
conventions.still_layer: page.html "still": k = scale (prepared frames are 1080x1920, so cover = 1); source point (cx*1080, cy*1920) lands on canvas (ax, ay); dx/dy shift after that. Defaults scale 1, cx 0.5, cy 0.5, ax 540, ay 960.
conventions.full: {dy}: the final canvas offset. 9:16 is always 0 (shifts and fills are baked into the frames). 4:5: mk_film full() already adds FD = -285, so pass o.dy = dy + 285.
conventions.punch: {scale, sx, sy, ax, ay}: cx = sx/1080, cy = sy/1920. All final canvas values (4:5 already includes its offset). "push" multiplies scale; "bump_dy" is dy on the first two frames.
conventions.lens: {scale, sx, sy}: "scale" is the value for mk_film lens(), which multiplies it by LENS.k (0.88 in 4:5), the entrance factor and the push; "effective" = scale x LENS.k. Lens 9:16 r 340 at (540,1270); 4:5 r 300 at (540,985).
conventions.porthole: {x, y, r, scale, sx, sy}: circle centre (x, y), radius up to r (easeOutBack open), 12 px Ink ring; source point (sx,sy) on the centre at "scale".
conventions.band: {dy}: final canvas offset of the frame, clipped to the band (9:16 y 1060-1920, 4:5 y 800-1350). When dy < 0, mk_film also draws an unshifted copy under it (no empty rows at the bottom).
conventions.tags: Type is unchanged: tag «حلو…» / «قهوة؟» / «عطر؟» / «برجر؟» 200 px (4:5 170), «حلويات؟» 180 px (4:5 153).

grounds: The worlds are natural now: coffee walnut and limewash, perfume near-black, burger STAKK red, sweet beige/steel (cake) or hot pink (kunafa). Tangerine, hot pink and azure stay only as the multiplication grounds and burst dots.
